paite: Ka hinna in Pathian kia angak a, amah a kipan in ka hotdamna ahong pawt ding ahi.
heading: David La / Pathian Kepbitna A Muanna
english: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.

paite: Amah kia ka suangpi leh hon hondampa ahi. Ka insang ahi a, nakpitak in ka ling kei ding hi.
english: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.

paite: Nou tengteng in, mi khat that ding a, baang awn leh gawl puk dekdek bang in bang tan ahia na sual ding uh?
english: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

paite: Athupina a kipan a sawnkhe ding lel in akihou ua; zuaugen akipah lamtak uh ahi a, akam un avualzawl ua, himahleh alungsim un hamsia aloh zel ngal uhi. Selah
english: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

paite: Ka hinna aw, Pathian kia ngak in; ka lametna amah kiang a kipan a pawt ahi ngal a.
english: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.

paite: Amah kia ka suangpi leh ka hotdamna ahi; ka insang ahi a, ka ling kei ding.
english: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.

paite: Pathian kiang ah ka hotdamna leh ka thupina a-om a; ka hatna suangpi leh ka kihumbitna Pathian ah a-om hi.
english: My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

paite: Nou mipite aw, chik lai peuh in leng amah muang unla, na lungtang uh ama ah sungbua un; Pathian ei a ding in kihumbitna ahi. Selah
english: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.

paite: Minamniamte bangmah lou lel ahi ua, minam liante leng zuau lel ahi uhi; bukna ah teh hi le uh, tuihu sang in azangzaw ding uh.
english: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.

paite: Nuaisiahna muang kei unla; aphatuam lou guktakna lamen kei unla, hauhnate ahong khanleh atung ah na lungtang uh nga kei un.
english: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.

paite: Pathian in khatvei agen a; hiai nihveitak ka zata hi; thilhihtheihna Pathian a ahi chih.
english: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.

paite: TOUPA aw, zahngaihna nang a mah ahi a, michih athilhih bangbang un na thuk ngal zel hi.
english: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.
